alkylation_concentration.evidence: Proteins were alkylated in a final concentration of 20 mM iodoacetamide in the dark at room temperature for 30 min.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: Proteins were alkylated in a final concentration of 20 mM iodoacetamide in the dark at room temperature for 30 min.

cleavage_agent.evidence: For the digestion step, 1 µg trypsin was added per 40 µg of protein and digestion was carried overnight at 37°C.

fragmentation_method.evidence: Full scan spectrum (350 to 1850 m/z, resolution 70,000, automatic gain control 3E6, maximum injection time 100 ms) was followed by high-energy collision-induced dissociation (HCD) tandem mass spectra with a run time of 90 min.

instrument.evidence: Liquid chromatography was followed by tandem MS (LC-MS/MS) and was performed on a Q-Exactive plus mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher).

ionization_type.evidence: A nanospray ion source (Thermo Scientific) was used.

labeling.evidence: inferred: Proteome Discoverer (2.1) software (Thermo Scientific) was used to perform database searching against the database containing Uniprot Human (Proteome ID: UP000005640, downloaded on 25 May 2016), using both Sequest and Mascot algorithms (in-house server).

mass_analyzer.evidence: inferred: HCD scans were acquired in the Orbitrap (resolution 17,500, automatic gain control 1E5, maximum injection time 80 ms).
